title: SMEs' Application and Commercialisation of Technologies Developed by A*STAR and Its Research Entities
what_it_is: SMEs' Application and Commercialisation of Technologies Developed by A*STAR and Its Research Entities

sections.label: SME licences under RIE2020
sections.summary: SME licences grew from 129 in FY2016 to 178 in FY2017, building on 627 licences issued from FY2011 to FY2015.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Under the Research, Innovation and Enterprise 2020 (RIE2020) programme, the number of licences taken up by SMEs grew from 129 licences in financial year (FY) 2016 to 178 licences in FY2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: This builds on A*STAR efforts under RIE2015, where A*STAR issued 627 licences to SMEs from FY2011 to FY2015.

sections.label: A*STAR researchers seconded to SMEs
sections.summary: Since the scheme's 2003 launch, A*STAR has seconded 769 researchers to SMEs, benefiting 678 SMEs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Since the launch of the scheme in 2003, A*STAR has seconded 769 researchers to SMEs, and this has benefited 678 SMEs.

sections.label: Companies supported since 2017 launch
sections.summary: Since the scheme's launch in 2017, 30 companies have been supported under this programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Since the launch of the scheme in 2017, 30 companies have been supported under this programme.

sections.label: OTRs and programme companies
sections.summary: A*STAR aims for 400 OTRs from FY2017 to FY2020, and 178 companies joined the programme from 1 April 2017 to 31 July 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: A*STAR aims to achieve 400 OTRs from FY2017 to FY2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Since 1 April 2017 to 31 July 2018, a total of 178 companies had joined the programme.

sections.label: Companies benefiting and IP Protocol
sections.summary: Around 600 companies have benefited since the programme's 2015 launch, and the Singapore National IP Protocol was updated in April this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Around 600 companies have benefited from the programme since its launch in 2015.

sentences.text: To expedite the commercialisation of IP, the Singapore National IP Protocol for Publicly Funded R&D was updated in April this year.
